comparator.name: UCR Liberal Arts and Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 Education and Examination Regulations specify 180 EC, Personal & Professional Development in the first year, at least 45 EC of advanced work, and a Liberal Arts & Sciences Portfolio and Reflection. The advanced requirement can be fulfilled with six 7.5 EC courses or with four advanced courses and a 15 EC Research Seminar in the third year. Each regular advanced course includes research. The BA or BSc and any cluster-specific major depend on course choice. The 180 EC on the left show the general degree requirements. The three examples use regular advanced courses.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest match owns the two generic programme-wide interests and demonstrates the defining cross-cluster Liberal Arts and Sciences model. All remaining generator-eligible interests are assigned to one of the six current official academic clusters. Business & Entrepreneurship and Data Science & Intelligent Systems are considered next in the official cluster order and both pass the evidence, coherence, distinctness and feasibility gates, so they are included as alternatives two and three. Environment & Sustainability, Government & Society, Health, Cognition & Behavior and Media, Culture & Communication are also coherent but cannot be added after the maximum of three alternatives is reached. Every schedule contains exactly 24 courses/180 EC, satisfies prerequisite and term constraints and includes at least six 300-level courses.
